Welcome to my Cloud Portfolio

Why this website exists

I believe the best way to learn is to do - as such I went and made this thing.

Of course rather than just being a one-off project this website also serves as my base of operations where I can share all of my projects, experience and achievements.

And who am I?

I appreciate the question. You may have already read my CV, but if not let me provide an explanation.

My name is Ivan, If I am doing my job and updating this site regularly, I should be 18 years old, living in Bulgaria and building a career in the Cloud and DevOps Engineering space.

I am self-taught (if you consider online courses, self-taught that is), despite being a university student, I know that the skills my education will provide won't be enough, I need something more.

As such, I have been learning from home for the past 6 months. I do have a strong passion for all of my creations and I am always eager to learn new things. As you might have also guessed, I enjoy humour and making cool stuff.
